latestVersion.changelog:
Self-Improvement Skill v1.0.0 — initial release

- Introduces a structured workflow and markdown format for capturing learnings, errors, and feature requests to support continuous improvement.
- Provides automatic first-use initialization of `.learnings/` directory and required log files without overwriting existing data.
- Outlines clear, privacy-focused guidelines for what to log and guards against recording sensitive or excessive information.
- Integrates with OpenClaw workspaces for agent-based workflows, with documentation for both OpenClaw and generic setups.
- Includes guidance for promoting broadly useful learnings to project memory files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SOUL.md).
- Offers optional hook integration for setup reminders and session-based sharing functionality.
